title: Typed prescribed-groundwater-level state-machine requirements for real-SWAP h-link research

current_reachability.conclusion: A real HLINK04 trial cannot currently be constructed through the admitted FMR typed boundary surface without adding new boundary/state semantics.

source_semantics.output_state: gwl plus accepted hydraulic profile and qbot

branch_above_or_at_top.condition: gwlinp >= top-node elevation minus source tolerance
behavior: construct vertical fluxes from top/process balance and storage changes
reconstruct the hydraulic profile upward/downward relative to prescribed gwlinp
qbot is diagnosed from the resulting flux chain
the generic nonlinear lower-boundary solve is bypassed for this source branch
reduce the active Richards unknown domain NN to the nodes above the prescribed groundwater level
represent saturated continuation below the active Richards domain
convert prescribed groundwater level to lower-face pressure head hbot=gwlinp-z_bottom_node+0.5*dz_bottom
use the same lower-face Darcy-gradient form as prescribed-head mode 5

source_semantics.branch_switching: The branch can change as prescribed groundwater level crosses the profile bottom or internal node geometry; the branch state is part of the physical/application semantics, not a cosmetic selector.
source_semantics.qbot_semantics: qbot is an output of the groundwater-level boundary solution, not an independently prescribed input.

minimum_typed_contract.control_coordinate: H_phreatic / prescribed groundwater-level elevation, distinct from mode-5 bottom pressure head
required_state: inside-profile versus below-profile continuation state or an equivalent deterministically reconstructible branch state
complete SWAP hydraulic/process state from the immutable accepted origin
active-domain geometry/NN semantics when groundwater lies inside the profile
required_outputs: accepted/diagnosed bottom flux qbot with source sign convention
complete-profile storage change over the window
all non-groundwater external process amounts needed for the h-link balance
branch/provenance diagnostics sufficient to prove which state-machine path was used
transaction_rules: Every H_phreatic trial starts from the same immutable accepted origin.
Rejected trials restore all hydraulic, groundwater-level, branch and numerical-continuation state.
Only the conjunctively accepted trial may advance SWAP lineage and physical mass authority.
No mode-1 state may leak into the existing mode-5 F-GC route.
minimum_typed_contract.time_rule: HLINK04 should use an explicit coupling-trial H_phreatic coordinate. Legacy DATE1/GWLEVEL interpolation is lineage evidence, not required as the first research control surface.
minimum_typed_contract.storage_rule: The typed trial must expose complete-profile storage change independently of qbot so the shared-phreatic residual can assign storage once.

required_qualification_slices.scope: Groundwater below the SWAP profile, where mode-1 must reduce exactly to the derived lower-face hbot relation.
required_qualification_slices.purpose: Establish mode-1/mode-5 boundary equivalence in the source-declared below-profile branch.

required_qualification_slices.scope: Groundwater inside the profile without optional processes.
required_qualification_slices.purpose: Qualify active Richards-domain truncation, saturated continuation, qbot output, Jacobian and mass closure.

required_qualification_slices.scope: Groundwater-level sweep across an internal node and the profile bottom.
required_qualification_slices.purpose: Qualify deterministic branch switching, rollback and continuity/discontinuity behavior.

required_qualification_slices.scope: Transactional replay/rejection from one accepted origin.
required_qualification_slices.purpose: Prove no branch or profile state leaks between H_phreatic trials.

hlink04_activation_rule: Do not implement GC-HLINK04 real-SWAP shared-phreatic trials until a research-only typed LOW01-A/B/D surface exists and LOW01-C branch-boundary behavior is at least characterized.
forbidden: do not expose legacy SWBOTB=1 wholesale as production
do not alias H_phreatic to bottom_head
do not use current mode-5 forcing adapter as evidence of groundwater-level-state semantics
do not bypass active-domain truncation or saturated continuation in the inside-profile branch
do not infer production admission from a research-only LOW01 harness
next: Keep current production F-GC mode 5 unchanged.
Close HLINK01 before implementing nonlinear h-link storage research.
If real h-link research remains desired, preregister a research-only LOW01-A/B/D adapter/harness as its own workstream rather than embedding it in HLINK04.
